Title: Approve vertical-slice scope
Body: Review the scene proposal and record approval. Acceptance: protected core and cut order are agreed.

Title: Lock player verbs
Body: Confirm move jump sword teleport and three guardian abilities. Acceptance: no additional critical verb is required.

Title: Create Unity URP project shell
Body: Create Unity 6 URP project folders Input Actions bootstrap scene and test scene. Enable Force Text serialization and Visible Meta Files. Acceptance: clean checkout opens without errors.

Title: Configure repository protections
Body: Apply main branch protection squash merge and required review after publishing. Acceptance: direct pushes are blocked.

Title: Implement player locomotion
Body: Add run jump fall facing and animation hooks. Acceptance: controller meets greybox movement values.

Title: Constrain the 2.5D movement plane
Body: Lock player enemies knockback and teleport destinations to the authored combat plane. Acceptance: no gameplay action drifts into depth.

Title: Build Cinemachine side-view rig
Body: Create camera rail framing dead zones transitions and impulse settings. Acceptance: player and required destination stay visible in greybox rooms.

Title: Implement teleport targeting
Body: Add aim range destination preview and obstruction checks. Acceptance: marker communicates valid invalid and out-of-range states.

Title: Implement teleport execution
Body: Add charges transit invulnerability arrival validation and recharge. Acceptance: 100 scripted attempts produce no clipping.

Title: Implement sword combat
Body: Add combo hitbox hurtbox damage and charge restoration. Acceptance: confirmed hits restore the configured amount.

Title: Add gamepad controls
Body: Map movement aiming attack teleport and ability inputs. Acceptance: prototype is fully playable without mouse.

Title: Run teleport feel test
Body: Test with three players on both input types. Acceptance: issues and tuning decisions are documented.

Title: Build boss state-machine framework
Body: Implement common intro select anticipation execution recovery stagger and death states. Acceptance: debug boss cycles through data-driven attacks.

Title: Build projectile pooling
Body: Support straight tracking radial and portal-sequenced projectiles. Acceptance: pool reuses instances without errors.

Title: Build elemental ability framework
Body: Create data resources cooldowns tags and acquisition state. Acceptance: debug ability can apply and query an element.

Title: Build clue interactions
Body: Support books stained glass mosaics and discovered state. Acceptance: clue prompt works on keyboard and gamepad.

Title: Greybox Ash Knight room
Body: Create boundaries spawn points hazards and clue placement. Acceptance: full encounter route is navigable.

Title: Implement Ash Knight
Body: Add burning armour water weakness three attacks and death reward. Acceptance: boss is defeatable only after armour exposure.

Title: Create reusable guardian placeholder models
Body: Build low-poly silhouettes on shared rigs with readable attachments and telegraphs. Acceptance: states remain distinguishable at 1080p.

Title: Build modular palace kit
Body: Create up to 15 reusable floor wall arch pillar platform and cage meshes. Acceptance: kit can greybox all four combat rooms without unique room geometry.

Title: Conduct first boss playtest
Body: Five attempts across at least three players. Acceptance: telegraphs and water clue findings are recorded.

Title: Implement Fire Dash
Body: Modify teleport to damage tagged targets and fragile objects. Acceptance: power works in debug and production rooms.

Title: Implement Drowned Warden
Body: Add flooding false bodies lightning stun and reward. Acceptance: encounter reset and success paths work.

Title: Implement Tidal Guard
Body: Absorb one eligible projectile and expose cooldown feedback. Acceptance: cannot absorb hazards tagged unblockable.

Title: Implement Hollow Oracle
Body: Add copies reflection reveal darkness pressure and reward. Acceptance: real form is deterministically discoverable.

Title: Implement Shadow Sight
Body: Reveal hidden ritual and tagged world objects. Acceptance: transition and accessibility visuals are readable.

Title: Build modular guardian rooms
Body: Reuse the palace kit with distinct lighting props and hazard silhouettes. Acceptance: all collision and teleport surfaces pass review.

Title: Add checkpoint flow
Body: Save guardian completion abilities and current room. Acceptance: death restarts at correct room with correct powers.

Title: Create guardian audio pass
Body: Add unique anticipation impact drain and victory cues. Acceptance: major attacks are identifiable without visuals.

Title: Greybox King chamber
Body: Place cage seals platforms obstacles and teleport bounds. Acceptance: final route is complete without art.

Title: Implement King projectile director
Body: Sequence tracking orbs beam portal barrage soul wave and memory shot. Acceptance: patterns are repeatable and tunable.

Title: Implement ritual seal logic
Body: Connect three abilities to three seal states and objective update. Acceptance: no seal can be bypassed or soft-lock the scene.

Title: Implement sorcerer finale
Body: Add cage fall final traversal strike and ending trigger. Acceptance: scene reaches credits state.

Title: Create throne-room 3D art pass
Body: Reuse the palace kit and produce the King cage ritual links platforms and final effects. Acceptance: cage remains readable during maximum barrage.

Title: Create final encounter audio
Body: Add projectile cues adaptive layers sorcerer warning and ritual reversal. Acceptance: cues remain distinct in full mix.

Title: Run end-to-end balance test
Body: Collect completion time deaths damage and clue comprehension from five players. Acceptance: results inform final tuning list.

Title: Fix P0 and P1 defects
Body: Resolve or formally defer all high-priority defects. Acceptance: no open P0 issue and accepted P1 list.

Title: Profile projectile performance
Body: Measure maximum barrage at 1080p. Acceptance: stable target frame rate on agreed machine.

Title: Complete accessibility pass
Body: Add remapping aim assist screenshake toggle flash reduction and volume controls. Acceptance: settings persist across restart.

Title: Package release build
Body: Export Windows build include controls and known issues. Acceptance: clean-machine smoke test passes.

Title: Finalize submission documents
Body: Proofread deliverables verify links and capture final evidence. Acceptance: submission package contains every required item.
